module_summary: Pulse (0-1-0) detector implemented as a 4-state Moore/Mealy FSM on data_in with a combinational output asserted on the falling edge from state s2.

anchors.name: pulse_level1
anchors.why: Pattern-tracking state register s0-s3; decoded to raise data_out.

anchors.name: data_in
anchors.why: Serial input bit steering FSM transitions and output.

anchors.name: data_out
anchors.why: Pulse-detected output, high when in s2 and data_in is 0.

groups.name: pulse_fsm
groups.description: Next-state logic, state register and output decode for 0-1-0 detection.
